subject.title: fix(agents): retry same profile before timeout auth rotation

question: Should ordinary assistant-stage timeouts retry the same model/profile once before spending auth-profile rotation or configured model fallback by default?
rationale: The patch is bounded and tested, but it intentionally changes runtime failover semantics for existing users with auth-profile pools and fallback models.

options.title: Accept bounded same-profile retry
options.body: Keep this PR's one-retry default so transient ordinary timeouts do not immediately mark or rotate the auth profile, then rely on the second timeout to reach the existing rotation/fallback path.

options.title: Keep immediate rotation/fallback
options.body: Reject or close this direction if existing users should continue to spend auth-profile rotation or model fallback on the first ordinary timeout.

options.title: Require a narrower rollout
options.body: Ask for a more limited policy, such as owner-approved gating or additional upgrade proof, before changing the default failover behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded same-profile retry
recommendation.body: Keep this PR's one-retry default so transient ordinary timeouts do not immediately mark or rotate the auth profile, then rely on the second timeout to reach the existing rotation/fallback path.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main ownership of the embedded runner files makes this the best available routing candidate for the final policy acceptance.
